scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names API,WEB "npm run dev --workspace @sprinters/api" "npm run dev --workspace @sprinters/web"
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.test:e2e: tsc --project tests/tsconfig.json && npm run build && playwright test
scripts.test:cross-browser: tsc --project tests/tsconfig.json && npm run build && playwright test --config playwright.cross-browser.config.ts
